column1: # zh-Hans: Pull requests on Bitbucket and Azure DevOps (简体中文).
Add a personal access token in Settings to see pull requests.
column2: 在设置中添加个人访问令牌，即可查看拉取请求。

column1: Azure DevOps
Azure DevOps lists nothing without a personal access token for the organization. Creating a pull request needs one with code read and write access.
column2: 没有组织的个人访问令牌，Azure DevOps 将无法列出任何内容。创建拉取请求需要一个具有代码读写权限的令牌。

column1: Bitbucket
Bitbucket and Azure DevOps are reached through their API, not a command-line tool.
column2: Bitbucket 和 Azure DevOps 通过其 API 访问，而不是通过命令行工具。

column1: Creating a pull request on {host} needs a personal access token. Add one under Settings, in Azure DevOps, then open this dialog again.
column2: 要在 {host} 上创建拉取请求，需要个人访问令牌。请在设置的 Azure DevOps 中添加一个，然后重新打开此对话框。

column1: Creating a pull request on {host} needs your username and an app password. Add them under Settings, in Bitbucket, then open this dialog again.
column2: 要在 {host} 上创建拉取请求，需要您的用户名和应用密码。请在设置的 Bitbucket 中填写，然后重新打开此对话框。
